evals.prompt: Upgrade our existing PURISTA app to version 4 without breaking production queues.
evals.expected_output: Creates a baseline and migration ledger, upgrades compatible package versions together, validates definitions with the installed CLI, and requires idempotency/retry evidence before rollout.

evals.prompt: Our cron handler runs billing inside every service replica. Move it to the current PURISTA pattern.
evals.expected_output: Separates an event-only scheduler host from business services, routes work through an event consumer or queue worker, requires occurrenceId idempotency, and rejects a local provider for replicated production hosts.

evals.prompt: Move our PURISTA HTTP callers to the new error response format.
evals.expected_output: Tests RFC 9457 Problem Details at the HTTP boundary, updates only affected consumers, and keeps EventBridge transport errors out of the claimed change.

evals.prompt: plz help migate my old purista project safely
evals.expected_output: Starts with package, lockfile, scripts, definitions, and baseline checks rather than blindly installing latest packages or regenerating application files.

evals.prompt: Create a new PURISTA customer service with an HTTP command.
evals.expected_output: Routes primary work to the purista skill and its CLI-first new-project workflow; migration guidance is not the primary skill for a greenfield feature.
